originality.rationale: The previous headline first-jump threshold and least height-33 witness are covered by OEIS A098197 and are explicitly credited. The surviving final claim is the complete list of all maximizers, not just the first occurrence, in each of the first 19 dyadic intervals, with exact multiplicities including a 44-to-1 collapse. The inspected sequence tables and primary paper do not supply the 19 complete argmax fibers. Best-knowledge originality remains subject to an unindexed extremizer census.
residual_risks: An older complete table or code enumeration of all Nontotient dyadic extremizers may exist outside inspected primary sources, public sequence tables and available indexed searches.
OEIS first-hit entries are previously published numerical assertions, not externally verified formal certificates; their pre-existence is evidence of known values rather than proof of mathematics.
The repaired result is a finite 19-scale classification and does not infer any later or asymptotic behavior.
